title: Bifrost Model Router Config
description: Configuration for the pi-bifrost query-aware model router. Maps user prompts to model tiers via regex rules and an optional LLM classifier. Merged from extension defaults → global → project root → project config (.pi/bifrost.json), with later layers winning.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the model router. When disabled, all requests use the default model.

default.description: Model tier to use when no rule matches and the classifier returns no category. Must match a key in 'models'.

strategy.description: Model selection strategy. 'first'/'fastest' picks first candidate (list should be pre-sorted). 'cheapest' sorts by input+output cost. 'cheapest_input' by input cost. 'cheapest_output' by output cost. 'largest_context' by context window. 'random' picks randomly.

categoryStrategies.description: Per-tier strategy overrides. Keys must match tier names in 'models'. If a tier is not listed here, 'strategy' is used.

models.description: Model tiers. Each key is a tier name (e.g. 'quick', 'general', 'frontier'). Values are provider/model patterns — either a single string or an ordered array of candidate patterns.

rules.description: Regex-based routing rules applied in order. First matching rule determines the model tier. Case-insensitive matching. If no rule matches, the 'default' tier is used. Prefer using bifrost-routes.json for project-specific rules — it overrides this field.

x-aiHints.danger: Wrong regex can misroute all requests. Test with /bifrost preview <prompt> before committing.

pattern.description: JavaScript regex pattern (without flags, double-escaped). Matched case-insensitively against the user's prompt. Example: '\\b(debug|fix|refactor)\\b'

model.description: Model tier name OR a direct model reference (e.g. 'provider/specific-model'). If the value contains '/', it's treated as an exact provider/id lookup and bypasses tier selection. Otherwise, it must match a key in the 'models' map.

ClassifierConfig.description: LLM-based classifier that inspects user prompts and selects a tier before falling back to regex rules. Set 'enabled: false' to use regex-only routing.

enabled.description: Enable the LLM classifier. When disabled, only regex rules are used.

backend.description: Classifier backend. Omit for existing prompt classifier; TypeSafe is explicit opt-in.

debug.description: Detailed TypeSafe operational trace with redacted metadata only; active only when global debug.enabled is true. Raw prompts, request bodies, provider responses, and external error text are never persisted.

model.description: Model pattern(s) for prompt classification. When backend is typesafe and fallback is prompt, this is the prompt fallback model; it is not the active Jev model.

endpoint.description: Prompt backend base URL. TypeSafe uses fixed nested typesafe.endpoint and rejects this field.

method.description: How to invoke the classifier. 'direct' uses a fast OpenAI-compatible HTTP call (needs compatible API). 'subprocess' spawns a fresh pi CLI (slower but supports any provider). 'auto' tries direct first, falls back to subprocess.

maxTokens.description: Max output tokens for the classifier. Keep it low — only need the category name back.

temperature.description: Temperature for classifier sampling. 0 for deterministic category selection.

fallbackToRegex.description: Fall back to regex rules when the classifier fails or returns an unknown category.

criteria.description: Provider-neutral criteria keyed by configured tier.

oneOf.description: Remove inherited criterion for this tier.

fallback.description: Fallback after a TypeSafe miss or rejected judgment. Prompt uses classifier.model; regex skips prompt classification.

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for the classifier. Override to change how categories are presented to the LLM.
systemPrompt.default: You are a routing classifier. Pick the category that best matches the task complexity and type. Respond with only the exact category name. No explanation, no punctuation.

CacheConfig.description: Fuzzy classification cache. Repeated or similar prompts reuse the cached category instead of calling the classifier again.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of cached entries. Oldest entries (by last use) are evicted first.

threshold.description: Jaccard similarity threshold for fuzzy cache matches. 0 = any prompt sharing at least one token with an entry matches (prompts with zero token overlap never match). 1 = only exact token matches.

ttlHours.description: Classification cache retention in hours. Default: 720 (30 days).

path.description: Custom path for the cache file. Absolute, ~-prefixed, or relative to project root. Default: .pi/bifrost-cache.jsonl

ReliabilityConfig.description: Health-aware model selection and circuit breaker. Tracks repeated probe/runtime failures, opens circuits for unhealthy models, and skips them before routing.

enabled.description: Enable circuit-breaker based model health filtering.

failureThreshold.description: Open model circuit after this many failures within windowMinutes.

cooldownMinutes.description: How long an opened circuit stays open before model becomes eligible again.

path.description: Custom path for persisted reliability state. Default: .pi/bifrost-reliability.json

DebugConfig.description: Structured debug logging. Appends JSONL lines to a file for performance analysis and troubleshooting. Disabled by default.

path.description: Custom path for the debug log file. Default: .pi/bifrost-debug.jsonl

ProbeConfig.description: Model probe tuning (/bifrost probe and /bifrost init). The probe sends a tiny prompt to every registry model; lower concurrency if providers rate-limit burst traffic.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of models probed simultaneously.
